sc_cat_item.description:
This request allows managers to upload a structured Excel file to automatically add or update workspace records in Workspace Reservation Request portal. Once submitted, the file will be processed and imported into the Workspace Options Catalog.

Please ensure your file follows the required format before submitting. Column headers and data must match the template shown below to ensure a successful import.

After processing is complete, you will receive a notification confirming whether the import succeeded or if any records require attention.
sc_cat_item.name: Workspace Options Import
sc_cat_item.short_description: Easily upload Excel files for workspace options import into ServiceNow
